anchor_binding.source_event: the frozen Create Purchase Order event in stable_anchor_id

temporal_semantics: strict precedence only when source timestamp is strictly earlier; equal timestamps are unordered
reason: A quotation may contain multiple Create Purchase Order events. Each pre-frozen audit anchor must bind M2 sensitive-event variable e_s to its own event rather than allow another action in the same quotation case to determine the anchor verdict.
claim_boundary: This is an audit-unit binding clarification, not a new motif family and not an outcome-selected rule.
